title: Avocado Night Cream vs Avocado Korean Night Cream: Which to Choose
ex: Same ₹649 price and ingredients, different texture and size. Which of our two avocado night creams suits your skin, weather and budget.

rd: Avocado night cream vs avocado Korean night cream: same ₹649 price and ingredients, different texture and size. See who should pick which and value per gram.
keyword: avocado night cream vs avocado korean night cream
quick: Both cost ₹649 and contain avocado, aloe vera, vitamin B3 and kojic acid. Choose the 30 g Avocado Night Cream for dry or tight-feeling skin and the best value per gram; choose the 25 g Avocado Korean Night Cream for a smooth, medium texture that suits most skin and humid weather.
facts: Avocado Night Cream: 30 g, about ₹21.6 per gram.
Avocado Korean Night Cream: 25 g, about ₹26 per gram.
Both contain kojic acid, so use one per night, not both.
A 30 g jar lasts about 6–8 weeks; 25 g about 5–6 weeks.
